The knowledge base confirms that this is due to the workspace running version 4.1 or earlier, which lacks full dark mode support and has a known defect on macOS for System Default mode. Low urgency question ticket, answer with these facts.
runs.customer_reply_draft:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out with your questions about dark mode.

Since you are on the Pro plan and only see 'Light' and 'System Default', it indicates your workspace is running an earlier software release (4.1 or older). This version lacks the full dark mode option and has a known issue on macOS where the 'System Default' setting only reads the OS theme at sign-in, so switching macOS to dark mode while the app is open will not change the app theme.

To fix this, your workspace admin can update to version 4.2 or later, which fully supports dark mode with an immediate effect when switching themes.

Regarding your question about scheduling dark mode to auto-switch at a specific time (like 6pm), this feature is not currently available, but it is a tracked feature request that the product team is considering.

If you need help applying the update or have other questions, feel free to ask!

Best regards,
Support Team

runs.rationale: Customer on Pro plan using workspace release 4.1 or earlier (evidenced by only Light and System Default options with no Dark mode toggle) is encountering expected behavior due to a release version limitation. Dark mode requires release 4.2 or later. Scheduling an auto-switch for dark mode at a specific time is currently not supported but is a tracked feature request, matching customer's query about scheduling.
runs.operator_summary: Customer on Pro plan cannot see Dark mode option because workspace is on release 4.1 or earlier. Dark mode support with an immediate toggle is available from release 4.2 onward. Scheduling dark mode changes at a time is not yet supported but is tracked as a feature request.
runs.customer_reply_draft: Hello! Thank you for reaching out. Currently, dark mode is supported only from workspace release 4.2 onward on Pro plans, which adds a distinct "Dark" option in Settings > Appearance. Your workspace is likely on an earlier release (4.1 or below), which is why you only see "Light" and "System Default" options. The "System Default" setting on macOS in earlier releases reads the OS theme only at sign-in, so switching macOS theme while the app is open does not update the app theme immediately. To get full dark mode support including instant toggle, please ask a workspace admin to update to release 4.2 or later from Settings > General. Regarding scheduling dark mode to switch automatically at a specific time, this feature is not currently available but it's a feature request we have noted. Thanks for your suggestion!
